hunks.baseline: “Ship-Fire Boy”: a child who lights fires aboard a ship.
hunks.sol: Ship-Fire Boy. A child who lights the fires aboard a ship.

hunks.baseline: It was a term for a boatman. At the same time, it was also a sobriquet belonging to one man.
hunks.sol: The term meant a boatman. It was also the sobriquet of one particular man.

hunks.sol: A crystalline gleam flashed in them. His skin was bronze and his body muscular, befitting a hardened river man. His bulging temples marked him as a Peak master who had reached a considerable realm.

hunks.baseline: A deep, low voice flowed between his dry lips. His subordinate answered with the utmost respect.

hunks.sol: Then there was only one possibility.

hunks.baseline: “A little over fifty. It doesn’t seem to be a merchant ship, either.”

hunks.sol: With that, the man closed his eyes again.

hunks.baseline: As always, his subordinates would handle it according to his orders.
hunks.sol: As always, his subordinates would carry out his orders.

hunks.baseline: *How dare they interrupt my meditation over something like this.*
hunks.sol: *Interrupting my meditation over something so insignificant.*

hunks.baseline: It had already been more than ten years since he reached the Peak realm. Now, however, an invisible wall stood in his way.
hunks.sol: It had already been more than ten years since he reached the Peak realm. Now, however, an invisible wall stood in his path.

hunks.baseline: He had tried consuming stolen elixirs and even smoking opium, which was said to reveal sights one had never experienced before, but it had all been a waste of time.
hunks.sol: He had tried consuming stolen elixirs and even smoking opium, which was said to reveal sights one had never experienced before. All of it had been a waste of time.

hunks.baseline: *This is going to be difficult at this rate.*
hunks.sol: *At this rate, I’ll never break through.*

hunks.baseline: But the man, who had only just entered his forties, harbored even greater ambitions.
hunks.sol: But the man had only just entered his forties, and his ambitions were greater still.

hunks.baseline: Anyone unaware of the circumstances might scoff at such an absurd ambition, but the man possessed the ability and background to support it.
hunks.sol: Anyone unaware of his circumstances might scoff at such a preposterous ambition, but the man possessed both the ability and the background to make it possible.

hunks.baseline: The proof was that, more than ten years ago, he had become the lord of Water Dragon Stronghold while only just past thirty.
hunks.sol: The proof was that he had become lord of Water Dragon Stronghold more than ten years ago, when he was barely past thirty.

hunks.baseline: The man drew a long breath. As he drew in and circulated the natural qi permeating the air, his sharpened senses gathered information from his surroundings.
hunks.sol: The man slowly exhaled. As he drew in and circulated the natural qi permeating the air, his sharpened senses gathered information from his surroundings.

hunks.baseline: The damp smell of water. The movement of the fast ship as it gradually slowed. Even the shouts and laughter of his subordinates.
hunks.sol: The damp smell of water. The swift ship gradually slowing beneath him. Even the shouts and laughter of his subordinates.

hunks.baseline: “You launched your ship without the permission of us heroes, so I assume you’re prepared for the consequences?”
hunks.sol: “You launched your ship without permission from us heroes. I assume you’re prepared for the consequences?”

hunks.baseline: “I-I committed a crime worthy of death by failing to recognize the heroes of the Yangtze. This isn’t much, but please accept it as a token of my sincerity…”
hunks.sol: “I-I’ve committed a crime worthy of death by failing to recognize the heroes of the Yangtze. This isn’t much, but please accept it as a token of my sincerity…”

hunks.baseline: No martial artist enjoyed having their training interrupted. His men might be rough and ignorant, but he had not expected them to be this incapable of understanding a simple order.
hunks.sol: No martial artist enjoyed having his training interrupted. His men might be rough and ignorant, but he had not expected them to be incapable of following such a simple order.

hunks.baseline: The man opened his eyes wide and was about to spring to his feet when—
hunks.sol: The man’s eyes snapped open. He was about to spring to his feet when—

hunks.baseline: Bang! Crack! Boom! Brrrrrap!
hunks.sol: Boom! Crack! Thud! Th-th-th-thump!

hunks.baseline: A series of savage noises rang out, and the surroundings fell silent.
hunks.sol: A savage barrage of noise erupted, and then everything fell silent.

hunks.baseline: *It seems to be over.*
hunks.sol: *It seems they’re finished.*

hunks.baseline: The man, somewhat mollified, closed his eyes again.
hunks.sol: Somewhat mollified, the man closed his eyes again.

hunks.baseline: Or he would have, if not for the question that suddenly flashed through his mind.
hunks.sol: Or he would have, if not for the question that suddenly crossed his mind.

hunks.baseline: At last, someone stopped directly outside the door and spoke in a voice laced with a yawn.
hunks.sol: At last, someone stopped directly outside the door and spoke through a yawn.

hunks.baseline: “What are you doing? Why aren’t you coming out?”
hunks.sol: “What are you doing? Aren’t you coming out?”

hunks.baseline: It was an unfamiliar voice, one he had never heard before.
hunks.sol: An unfamiliar voice. He had never heard it before.

hunks.baseline: An alarm rang through the man’s mind.
hunks.sol: Alarm bells rang in the man’s mind.

hunks.baseline: The man rose at the speed of a streak of light and shot toward the door.
hunks.sol: The man shot to his feet and streaked toward the door like a beam of light.

hunks.baseline: His fist, carrying enough power to smash even a massive sailing ship, shattered the thick wooden door and raced toward the enemy beyond it.
hunks.sol: His fist, carrying enough power to smash apart a massive sailing ship, shattered the thick wooden door and hurtled toward the enemy beyond it.

hunks.baseline: A deafening boom and its aftershock shook the fast ship.
hunks.sol: A deafening boom and its aftershock rocked the swift ship.

hunks.baseline: The man stared at the enemy with his eyes wide open.
hunks.sol: The man stared wide-eyed at his enemy.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, he stared at the palm that had stopped his fist.
hunks.sol: More precisely, at the palm that had stopped his fist.

hunks.baseline: A boiling voice escaped between his clenched teeth.
hunks.sol: A seething voice escaped between his clenched teeth.

hunks.baseline: Flames poured from the eyes of the man known as the Ship-Fire Boy, Mu Song.
hunks.sol: Flames blazed in the eyes of the man known as the Ship-Fire Boy, Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: I kicked the leg of the middle-aged man sprawled out on the deck.
hunks.sol: I kicked the leg of the middle-aged man sprawled flat on his back across the deck.

hunks.baseline: “How long are you going to keep staring at the sky? Get up. Quickly.”
hunks.sol: “How long are you going to stare at the sky? Hurry up and get up.”

hunks.baseline: Focus returned to his hazy eyes. The middle-aged man propped up his upper body and stared at me with a dazed expression.
hunks.sol: Focus returned to his glassy eyes. He pushed himself upright and stared at me in a daze.

hunks.baseline: “H-how did you make such easy work of the Ship-Breaking Fist…?”
hunks.sol: “H-how did you defeat the Ship-Breaking Fist so easily…?”

hunks.baseline: Now I remembered.
hunks.sol: Right. Now I remembered.

hunks.baseline: I had definitely seen that martial art somewhere before, but my memory had been so hazy that I had been wondering about it.
hunks.sol: I had definitely seen that martial art somewhere before, but the memory had been so hazy that I couldn’t place it.

hunks.baseline: I looked the middle-aged man up and down with renewed interest.
hunks.sol: Intrigued, I looked the middle-aged man up and down.

hunks.baseline: “Cheol, Cheol Soo? Who are you talking about?”
hunks.sol: “Cheol… Soo? Who are you talking about?”

hunks.sol: *I heard he forfeited right afterward and went straight home.*

hunks.sol: “The Cheol Soo you mentioned is the youngest of us three martial brothers. He’s the third Disciple, and I’m the second.”

hunks.sol: Huh. I had heard that before too.

hunks.sol: People had gone on endlessly about the Iron-Water Divine Dragon’s Master.

hunks.sol: “That’s right. My Master is the man known as the Seafaring King.”

hunks.sol: I helped the bewildered middle-aged man to his feet and brushed the dust from his clothes.

hunks.sol: “Look how dirty your clothes got. What a disaster. You’ll have to get them dry-cleaned.”

hunks.sol: “Of course. Do I look like the sort of ill-bred junior who would lie to his Senior?”

hunks.sol: I followed his eyes and saw a flag flying high above the swift ship.
